title: Settings silently resets the SERVER models root when the stored path contains 'temp'/'tmp'
description: Opening the Settings panel can silently repoint the models root at the default, orphaning a user's whole model library. MpiSettings.js:348-354 runs a legacy guard on MOUNT: if the localStorage models path contains 'temp' or 'tmp' ANYWHERE (substring, case-insensitive) it calls _setComfyPath(''), which POSTs /comfy/set-path with an empty path; comfy.js:500-506 treats falsy as 'revert to default' and rewrites extra_model_paths.yaml to getDefaultModelsRoot(). That YAML is the SINGLE source of truth - /comfy/get-path reads it directly and nothing else remembers the real root. The route logs ONLY on error, so a successful reset leaves no trace anywhere. Hit live 2026-07-29: a user's root flipped from G:/CubricModels (144GB) to <engine>/mpi_models with no log line, and the local engineAsset repair then re-downloaded sam3-multiplex (1.75GB) that already existed at the real root. Trigger that session was almost certainly localStorage poisoned by MPI-387's CUBRIC_ENGINE_ROOT=C:/tmp/fake-engine testing (MpiEngineInstall.js:229 stores whatever is in the models field), but the SHIPPING risk is a user whose models folder legitimately contains those letters - D:/AI/temp_models, a username like Temperance - who loses the root every single time they open Settings and sees their library as uninstalled. FIX DIRECTION: the guard only ever needed to clear localStorage; reaching through to server state is the overreach. Drop the _setComfyPath('') call, or match a REAL temp dir (os.tmpdir prefix) instead of a substring, and require confirmation before any reset. Separately add a success log line to /comfy/set-path - its absence is the only reason this took an investigation rather than 30 seconds. Guard dates to f41ffdc5 (2026-04-07).
acceptance: A models path containing 'temp'/'tmp' no longer rewrites extra_model_paths.yaml on Settings mount
The guard (if kept at all) touches localStorage ONLY - never server state - and never fires without the user's say-so
Substring matching replaced by a real temp-dir test, or the guard deleted outright if its original reason is gone
POST /comfy/set-path logs its successful writes: old root -> new root, and who asked
A test pins it: mounting Settings with a temp-ish stored path must leave the YAML byte-identical
Sweep the other _setComfyPath('') style calls + MpiEngineInstall.js:229 for the same overreach
